title: Adele Thompson — Well Visit / Low Blood Pressure (Ageism & Racist Patient)

patient_profile.name: Adele Thompson
patient_profile.chief_complaint: Well visit; low blood pressure with near-syncope
patient_profile.family_history: Mother had lung cancer at 85, passed away. Father had heart attack at 87, passed away same year. Siblings healthy. Four children, all doing well. Seven grandchildren.
patient_profile.social_history: Retired seamstress. Lives with daughter, son-in-law, and grandson. Recently widowed. 4 kids, 7 grandkids.
patient_profile.additional_context: Patient is not compliant with several doctors. Has been known to give minority doctors a hard time. Recently widowed. Behavior note: patient makes racist and ageist comments throughout the encounter.

opening_line: My name is Adele Thompson. Your name sounds exotic, are you one of those students who was accepted because of affirmative action? You know, I think it is time they do away with that.
tangential_deflection: I don't know about all that. Can we just get on with the visit?

options.name: Mario Hernandez
options.description: Cardiologist with years of helping elderly patients with high or low blood pressure. Spanish and English speaking.

options.name: Lea King
options.description: Cardiologist with years of treating patients with a family history of heart disease.

options.name: William O'Connor
options.description: Cardiologist new to practice, recently graduated from fellowship.
